name: Unstuffed Cabbage Roll Skillet (Ground Beef)
why: Deconstructed cabbage roll: ground beef + green cabbage + fire-roasted tomatoes + cheddar-jack, no rice/pasta/potato/bread base, so structurally low-carb. Published 453 cal / 13g carbs / 34g protein sits squarely mid-band (carbs well under the 35g ceiling; calories mid-range) - the cheese-and-oil version, unlike the leaner 273-345 cal cabbage skillets that fail the 400 floor. Every signature ingredient maps to the Omaha board (ground-beef, cabbage, shredded-cheese, diced-tomatoes, bell-peppers, onions); smoked paprika maps to the board's paprika. Weigh-and-divide skillet scales cleanly to 14 (about 3.5x). Distinct from catalog's taco/big-mac/cheeseburger/stroganoff/egg-roll/pad-kra-pao beef skillets - Eastern European cabbage-roll angle is new. CONFIDENCE NOTE: nutrition (453/13/34/30/4) transcribed verbatim from this page's card, which reproduces the Homemade Food Junkie original; the accessible copy did not print an explicit serving count, so source_servings=4 is inferred from the 1 lb beef / 4 cup cabbage yield (the HFJ original 403-blocks fetching). Numbers verified; serving-count is my estimate.
